admission_requirements.general_requirements: Tawjihi (General Secondary Education Certificate) or equivalent (IB, SAT, IGCSE) with equivalency from Jordanian Ministry of Education; unified admission through Ministry of Higher Education for regular program; parallel program admission directly through university
admission_requirements.exam_details: Selective admission based on entrance examinations and past academic records; proficiency exams in Arabic and English for admitted students; specific programs may have additional entrance requirements
admission_requirements.english_requirement: English proficiency required for scientific and medical programs; proficiency exam may be taken upon admission

tuition_fees.annual_fees_range: 900 - 4,500 JOD per year (approximate, varies by faculty and program type)
tuition_fees.notes: Fees vary by faculty and admission type (regular/parallel). Per credit hour ranges: humanities 30-50 JOD, business/IT 30-65 JOD, nursing/health 50-75 JOD, pharmacy 60-90 JOD, medicine 100-150 JOD, engineering 40-80 JOD. Parallel program fees are higher.

ranking_accreditation.accreditation: MOHE (Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research), AQACHEI (Accreditation and Quality Assurance Commission for Higher Education Institutions)
ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: THE World University Rankings 2026: 601-800; QS World University Rankings 2026: 851-900; US News Best Global Universities 2025-2026: #1188 [uncertain]

market_demand.notes: Yarmouk University has strong programs in medicine, pharmacy, and engineering. Jordan faces general youth unemployment challenges (~25% for graduates). University hosts business incubators and entrepreneurship centers to improve graduate employability.

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: On-campus housing available (السكنات الطلابية); limited furnished apartments for international students and staff (200-250 JD/month for one-bedroom); most male students live off-campus in private housing near the university in Irbid
campus_facilities.scholarship_details: Merit-based scholarships for outstanding academic performance, need-based financial aid, government-funded scholarships (makromat for military, teachers, camp residents), research and teaching assistantships for postgraduate students

contact_info.address: Irbid - Jordan, P.O. Box 566, Postal Code 21163
